verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own documented features support acting on many resources at once. Programs use real-language loops to define resources in bulk (pulumi-gh-1). `pulumi preview --import-file` generates an import file listing every resource for bulk adoption (pulumi-docs-21). Automation API drives create/update/destroy programmatically (pulumi-docs-34), and policies apply consistently across all resources (pulumi-docs-16). A community user reports running deployments of about 500 resources each (pulumi-comm-12). However, bulk operations are implied by the declarative many-resource model rather than documented as a feature. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-operations capability (e.g. batch delete/tag/update across stacks or resources), documentation of fan-out across many stacks, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows driven by AI agents.
